cards.note: Already the official npm-package form: package.json declares dsh.bundle.patch and the profile composes it through dsh.profile.bundles; no repository-plugins reference exists in the tree.
package.json already declares the merged dsh.client (platform web + inject); no legacy dshClient field and no dsh.plugin.json anywhere.
dsh.client is declared with platform web and the exports['./client'] bundle; the inject edges were recomposed for the alpha.2 providers.
Every consumed service is declared: the browser half injects sessions/locale/slots (client.js:41) and the host half injects nothing; no ctx.get on an undeclared service.
The plugin consumes no optional host service; d399Games is a service it provides, not one it probes.
No session/event subscription and no event-field derivation; the browser half reads only the ISessions.list snapshot.

The browser half does read ctx.sessions, but at 0.1.2-alpha.2 'sessions' is a first-class client service provided by @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller, so the Node-half aggregation workaround does not apply.
No task/run output tailing; the plugin never touches tasks.read or a peek API.
No httpServer/tasks/onTaskDone usage; the host relay listens on webserver/index-inject, whose name the 0812 rename leaves unchanged.
No ImageAttachmentRef, read_image, or persisted image metadata in the plugin.
The plugin neither registers, wraps, parses, nor snapshots read_image output.
No LLM adapter, image request interceptor, or attachment upload cache.
No ctx.remote or Host APIProxy usage; the browser half consumes cordis services only.
Target is alpha.2 (where DSH-0.1.2-A2-01 restores ignorable), and the plugin produces no persisted SessionEvents.
No host-source patch and no internal session-view import; the browser half imports public /client subpaths only.
Not a launcher wrapper or SDK/ACP integration; the plugin reads no profile file and hardcodes no user directory.
Not a headless wrapper or stdout/stderr parser.
No tool-presentation mode, PTC preset, or dispatch-waterfall usage.
No permission, approval, or web_fetch policy code.
No custom loopback HTTP/WS/RPC route, browser page, or /api route; the host half only contributes an index-injection global into the authenticated page.
Not a model-provider plugin and it registers no login configuration.
Locale copy already goes through the public ctx.locale.register(ns, {zh, en}) API; the plugin carries no i18n patch to retire.
No subagent orchestration or provider/model selection.
Informational for DeepSeek-adapter deployments; this plugin makes no LLM request.
No PowerShell/Bash persistence or Windows directory-picker workaround.
session-log-deepseek is not used or enabled by the plugin.
No browser acceptance script in the tree; the README verification step names --dump-config and a web boot check without hardcoding a URL, bundle path, or log format.
No user-questions answerer registration.
Not a host UI/session-management plugin; no agent-preset resolution or preset roots.
No TPS computation or StreamChunk inspection.
The plugin owns one inserted row, not a composition reusing dsh-base; it takes no telemetry stance.
Does not import @earendil-works/pi-ai or any provider/auth package.

The removed @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime is gone from the source and from dsh.client.inject/peers; Context comes from @deepseek-ai/cordis and ISessions/SessionListState from @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller/client.

Condition not met: the assembly row names the bare package name ('@bench/dsh-bench-d399-overlay') and package.json#name is the baseline; the bundle registration id is emitted by the (elided) tsdown banner, which upstream sets to the package name.
Reads the sessions list (SessionSummary.running), not session timelines or user message content.
No composer DOM manipulation, draft injection, or history recall.
Does not render MarkdownText or fenced CodeBlocks.
No ctx.connection.api usage and no history/transcript read.
Constructs no subagent descriptor and asserts no subagent/descriptor shape.
No IWorkspaces navigation or directory-UI calls.
The plugin produces no third-party persisted SessionEvent.
No ctx.remote calls, so no RemoteResult/RemoteError handling to migrate.

Peers trimmed to the packages the source names or injects (dsh-client-runtime and the unused dsh-invariants peer removed) and pinned to the ^0.1.2-alpha.2 cohort; no lockfile exists in this fixture, so resolution was not installed here.
No Node-version workaround or CI matrix in the tree.
Does not consume pluginInventory/list or validate PluginInventorySnapshot.
No host.describe call and no $host state read.
The plugin mounts no tool/agent/session-projection package; it composes into the shipped web bundle as a leaf UI row.
No ctx.settings.register/update/get usage; the configuration entry point is the composition row config, not a settings namespace.
